notes.title: Almost here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36148686/0a2a6136a749fd7f4f2e6cc705220d129ea71597.jpg[/img]
Yes, It is true, we missed the release date and let you without VR Katherine for more than 2 weeks! 

We added Valve Index to the project and corrected some performance issues! 

We are ready to give you the game! We only need to wait for the review process to end! We believe that in less than one week the game will be here! 

When released, you will be able to play:
- WITHOUT VR devices
- Oculus Rift
- Vive
- Valve Index
- Knuckles
- Suitable VR devices with SteamVR.

Emergency mode:
You can play with a Drone with the flying algorithm from Flywings Flight Simulators!

The feature was created for you to suddenly change between the VR Katherine game to a drone simulator game! We think that this feature is really useful! 

You are not going to regret the waiting! We hope you like it!
